output.reason: Several weeks of intermittent post-fatty-meal right upper quadrant pain without reported fever or jaundice fits a suspected gallstone pattern that needs a clinician to arrange ultrasound and follow-up, but reported features do not require emergency or same-day hands-on care.
output.patientMessage: Start a message review with a Counsel clinician in this thread; your pattern of on-and-off right upper belly pain after fatty meals over a few weeks suggests possible gallstones and needs an ultrasound arranged. Meanwhile, lighter low-fat meals may reduce attacks. Seek emergency care now if pain lasts more than a few hours, or you develop fever, chills, yellow eyes or skin, persistent vomiting, or a rigid tender belly.
differential: Biliary colic from gallstones (episodic postprandial RUQ pain)
